exposure: postpartum timing (first day vs seventh day)
cohort: The study included 95 postpartum patients who underwent C-section delivery at Santo Antonius Hospital in Pontianak, West Kalimantan.
finding: The prevalence of Lower Urinary Tract Symptoms (LUTS) differed significantly between the first and seventh days of the postpartum period in C-section patients, with most symptoms decreasing on day seven while six specific symptoms (insensible urinary incontinence, hesitancy, urinary retention, feeling of incomplete emptying, bladder pain, and dysuria) increased.
mod_finding: The study observed that the duration of the postpartum period affects the prevalence and progression of LUTS following C-section delivery.
cross-section timing: Data was collected 12 hours after urinary catheter removal and on the seventh day of the postpartum period.
